photo_prints.faq_size_q: Which print styles can I choose?
photo_prints.faq_size_a: Choose classic Polaroid-style prints, square prints, vertical prints, horizontal prints or larger portrait and landscape prints. Each style shows its exact dimensions before you order.
photo_prints.faq_photos_q: Can I order multiple copies of one photo?
photo_prints.faq_photos_a: Yes. Use Copies below each photo. The total number of copies must match your selected print quantity. You can replace, remove or crop each photo separately.
photo_prints.faq_delivery_a: Allow approximately 2–3 days for making and 5–6 days for shipping. Actual delivery depends on your location and courier service. Contact Cartwala for an urgent order.
photo_prints.faq_return_q: What if there is a problem with my prints?
photo_prints.faq_return_a: Contact Cartwala with your order number and photos of the issue. Personalised orders are covered by our published refund policy.

photobooks.faq1: How do I create my photo album?
photobooks.answer1: Choose a theme and cover design. Select the size and paper. Upload at least 26 photos. Create the album, adjust any photo and review every page before adding it to cart.
photobooks.answer2: The price includes 24 inner pages and the cover. Extra pages are charged at the rate shown for your size and paper. The total updates before you order.
photobooks.faq3: Can I change the cover and photo order?
photobooks.answer3: Yes. Edit the cover title and message, move photos earlier or later and replace any photo. The first photo is used on the front cover and the last on the back cover.
photobooks.answer4: Making takes approximately 2–3 days and shipping approximately 5–6 days. Delivery depends on your address. See our shipping policy for details.
photobooks.faq5: What if there is a problem with my album?
photobooks.answer5: Contact Cartwala with your order number and photos of the issue. We will help according to our refund policy.
photobooks.layout_hint: More photos per page means fewer pages. The minimum is 24 inner pages.
